# <!-- @brand:appName -->Tymar<!-- /@brand:appName -->

> <!-- @brand:descriptionLong -->Tymar is a minimal, powerful time tracking app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Focus on your work while Tymar handles the rest.<!-- /@brand:descriptionLong -->

## Key facts

- **Platforms:** macOS, Windows, and Linux. Pre-built binaries on GitHub Releases.
- **License:** MIT. Full source on GitHub.
- **Tech stack:** Tauri 2 (Rust backend + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 frontend). This marketing site is Next.js.
